name: Swiss Grid
signature: White page, flush-left heavy grotesque, strict 12-column grid, one red signal.

contrast.note: Light theme. Red is safe as text on both backgrounds. Red is the only color; everything else is black, grey and white.

type.eyebrow: 0.8125rem, weight 700, accent color, preceded by a section number like 01

motion.rule: Precise slide: elements slide in from the left 36px over 500ms with a 60ms stagger, aligned to the grid, never rotating or scaling.

hero.layout: Headline set very large across 8 of 12 columns, flush left, tight leading, with a giant section index in the margin. One square photo snapped to the grid beside it; call link as a large red phone number.
hero.photo: Real photo, square crop, no overlay.

background: Pure white. Optional 12-column hairlines at 6% ink opacity in the hero only. Alternate sections use the surface color as full-bleed bands.

button.fill: Accent fill, white label, trailing arrow icon.
button.label: Sentence case, weight 700, no tracking.
button.hover: Invert on press with data-press; no easing, no glow.
